Patient Journey Coverage

Only 1 of 4,597 patients could be linked across more than one department using name/age/gender matching. No persistent Patient ID or referral field existed in the source data, so cross-department journey reconstruction is a data-structure limitation, not necessarily an indication that referrals did not occur.
